fullDescription: A vibrant, dark-mode emergency monitoring dashboard featuring high-energy red and orange gradients, seismic grid backdrops, and real-time pulse animations. This design system utilizes a high-contrast palette of electric pinks and warm oranges against a deep obsidian background, perfect for fintech, security, or disaster response platforms. Key elements include bento-style stat cards, severity-coded alert components, and editorial typography using Clash Grotesk and Satoshi. The interface is characterized by 'cyber' aesthetics like scanline flickers, glowing hot-lines, and concentric ripple animations for high-urgency notifications.
prompt:
## Resumo
Gising! is a high-urgency, dark-mode monitoring dashboard designed for real-time alert systems. It features a bold, vibrant aesthetic with red/orange gradients, seismic-themed background textures, and sophisticated micro-interactions including pulse ripples and staggered entrance animations.

## Estilo Visual
Create a high-contrast dark mode UI using background #0a0608. Implement a 'seismic grid' background with 28px grid lines in rgba(255,45,85,0.04). Use a primary gradient of #ff2d55 to #ff6a00 for branding and CTA elements. Typography: Titles in 'Clash Grotesk' (bold, letter-spacing: -1px to -2px), body in 'Satoshi'. UI accents: Red (#ff2d55), Orange (#ff6a00), Muted Pink (#ff9ab0), and Muted Rose (#6b3345). Buttons should have a 110-degree gradient, 0px 4px 24px glow shadows, and a top-inset 1px white border at 15% opacity. Animation specs: Staggered fade-up entry (translateY: 20px to 0, 0.5s duration, 0.05s increments), concentric pulse rings (2s ease-out ripple), and a horizontal 2px scanline moving vertically with 6s duration.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Header and Top Branding
Top-fixed header with a glowing 'hot-line' border (2px height, gradient transparent to #ff2d55 to transparent). Left side features a logo icon in a 36px square with a 135-degree red-orange gradient and a notification-bell icon on the right in a #130b0e card container. Greeting text uses 18px Clash Grotesk for the name and 11px uppercase Satoshi for the 'Good morning' label.

### Live Status Bar
A full-width pill container with a 10% opacity red background and 28% opacity red border. Contains a live 'Radio' icon with concentric pulse ripples (#ff2d55 border) and bold status text in 11px uppercase Satoshi. Must include a 'LIVE' indicator on the right in Clash Grotesk.

### Statistics Grid
A horizontally scrollable row of 'Bento' style cards (min-width: 110px). The 'Hot' card uses a 135-degree gradient background (rgba(255,45,85,0.16) to rgba(255,106,0,0.08)) with a 30% red border. Standard cards use #130b0e background with #2e1520 borders. Large metrics (30px) in Clash Grotesk with secondary labels in 10px Satoshi.

### Severity-Coded Alert Cards
Vertical list of 2xl rounded cards. High-severity cards use a gradient background (rgba(255,45,85,0.14) to 0.05) and a 35% opacity red border. Medium-severity cards use orange gradients. Each card features a 40px icon with double pulse ripples, a status badge (e.g., 'HIGH' in 9px Clash Grotesk), and a secondary action row with a primary gradient CTA button and a ghost-style share button.

### Region and Activity Logs
Region lists are rendered as 'pills' with 8px opacity backgrounds and left-aligned icons. Activity logs use a timeline style where items have 3px solid left borders color-coded to the event type (High: #ff2d55, Medium: #ff6a00, Default: #2e1520). Items include timestamp on the right in 10.5px muted text.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Concentric Alert Ripple — A high-urgency visual indicator for active emergencies.
A central 22px circle containing a glyph icon, surrounded by two concentric rings. Animation: 'ripple' 2.2s ease-out infinite. Ring 1: scale 1 to 2.6, opacity 0.7 to 0. Ring 2: 0.75s delay. Border color: rgba(255,45,85,0.6).

### Gradient Hot-Line — A UI separator that acts as a 'digital pulse' at the top of the viewport.
Absolute positioned div, 2px height. Background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, #ff2d55 40%, #ff6a00 60%, transparent 100%). Box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255,45,85,0.8).

### Seismic Backdrop — Layered radial gradients and grid to create depth.
Layer 1: Deep black #0a0608. Layer 2: Seismic grid lines 1px at 28px intervals in rgba(255,45,85,0.035). Layer 3: Three radial ellipses. Ellipse A: 50% top, 320x200px, red (0.18 opacity). Ellipse B: 95% right, 200x220px, orange (0.10 opacity). Ellipse C: bottom left, 160x180px, red (0.07 opacity).

style.description: The style is 'Cyber-Energetic'—a mix of high-tech dashboarding and editorial design. It uses a dark base (#0a0608) with electric accents (#ff2d55, #ff6a00). Typography pairs the bold, geometric 'Clash Grotesk' for headings with the clean, modern 'Satoshi' for body text. Animations are critical: staggered fade-ups for page entry, pulse rings for active alerts, and a subtle scanline flicker to enhance the 'live' feel.
